public_rationale: Google's reported developer adoption is material evidence against a broad claim that little AI activity exists elsewhere. It does not settle the narrower commercial claim in context: paid demand remaining after OpenAI and Anthropic are removed. The retrieved disclosures do not isolate that amount for the target quarter. Treating all usage as paid demand, or all cloud revenue as independent AI demand, would overstate the evidence.
limitations: A broader reading that counts free usage would make Google's figures more directly adverse to the claim.
Substantial demand would not by itself establish that the entire proposed infrastructure buildout is justified.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Excluding OpenAI and Anthropic, there is not much demand for AI services.

statement.excerpt: Every article about building them automatically assumes this is a necessary buildout because lots of money has gone into them, but nobody can seem to explain why other than “there’s so much demand for AI services (which is not actually true when you remove OpenAI and Anthropic).”

from_speaker: there’s so much demand for AI services
not actually true when you remove OpenAI and Anthropic
our_interpretation: Assess the parenthetical demand claim, not the separate assertion about every article.
The plain commercial reading is that realized demand remaining outside OpenAI and Anthropic is small. A finding that demand exists would not alone contradict that claim.
Exclude those companies' own purchases and demand for their models resold through other providers. The post does not clearly distinguish these two exclusions.
Use April–June 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter whose results could have been reported before publication.
Substantial paid adoption or consumption could contradict the ordinary reading. Free usage, downloads and total cloud revenue alone do not measure the remaining commercial demand.
criteria.support_condition: Credible measurements show that commercial AI-service demand remaining after the exclusions is small across the market.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible measurements show substantial realized paid AI-service adoption or consumption outside the excluded companies and their resold services.
